howto.what: 为项目添加 Matrix 频道支持：从 channels 分支复制 Matrix 适配器到 src/channels/，注册导入，安装固定版本依赖，修补 matrix-js-sdk 的 ESM 导入，最后运行构建和测试。之后需配置独立的机器人账号凭据。
howto.when: 当用户要求给项目添加 Matrix 频道集成，或处于 /setup 流程中需要接入 Matrix 时触发。

say.text: 给项目接入 Matrix 频道
say.note: 将复制并注册 Matrix 适配器，安装依赖并完成构建测试。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人账号
把 Matrix 频道接到代理组

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support to the project: copies and registers the Matrix adapter, installs a pinned dependency, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then runs build and tests. Later requires configuring a separate bot account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Matrix channel integration, or during the /setup flow when Matrix needs to be connected.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel to the project
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs deps, and verifies with build/tests.
Prompts for homeserver URL, user ID, and display name.

say_en.text: Wire the Matrix channel to an agent group
